notes.title: ~Rebalancing + Demo Update~
notes.notes:
I figured a lot of changes were made, so the demo should be updated as well since it doesn't play the same anymore


FULL GAME
CHANGES:
 Green and interest tiles are now temporary.

 The price of Interest and Green tiles don't scale with each board anymore.

 Scoring has been adjusted.

 Chording doesn't trigger mines when having a shield anymore.

 Prices now scale with rank.


DEMO
The demo has been updated and now has all the fixes and changes from the current version, differences:

No achievements

Only first 2 Faces can be played (Jimmy/Joe)

Only first 2 flags can be used (Red/Blue)

notes.title: --Dragging the camera, bugfixes and more!--
notes.notes:
I heard some people wanted to be able to drag the board to see better, so i did that!
Also, got rid of more annoying bugs and changed some stuff for better communication


--CHANGES--
 You can drag the board by pressing middle click, to see better at higher zoom levels

 Faces now wear sunglasses when you still have uses of your ability, and have a poker-face when you got no uses left, as an indicator.

 Face description also changes when you can't currently use you ability

 The game now remembers the last face, flag and rank you selected.

 At the bottom of the shop, progression is now clearer so you know what challenge you're facing next

 Jimmy's Description is now shorter to avoid confusion.

 Social media has been moved to a corner instead of being with the rest of the menu

Added version number to the bottom of main menu to help with bug reports


--FIXES--
Safe clicks don't get disabled when clicking a flagged tile. This also fixes the Regular Joe bug where it wouldn't let you use the ability right after.

 Safe clicks don't get disabled with chording anymore.

 Fixed a bug where blue flag wouldn't allow you to use your skill after use

 Fixed a bug where blue flag would kill you if you hit a mine on your first click, instead of relocating it.
